lines.speaker: Keeper
lines.text: David, your father is waiting in the courtyard. I will watch the flock while you go to him.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Thank you. Keep them near the water. I will go to my father.

lines.speaker: Jesse
lines.text: David, my son. Come here. I have an errand for you.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I am here, Father. What would you have me do?

lines.speaker: Jesse
lines.text: Take this roasted grain and these loaves to your brothers at the camp. Take these cheeses to their commander. See how your brothers are, and bring me word of them.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I will go, Father. I will take the provisions and bring you news of my brothers.

lines.speaker: Jesse
lines.text: Go, my son. May the Lord be with you.
